definitions.explanation: For birds, insects, or aircraft to fly in various directions.

definitions.gloss: to rush about, to be busy going places
definitions.explanation: To move energetically from place to place (figurative use for people).

examples.english: Butterflies are flying around the flowers.
Small birds were flying from tree to tree.
When summer comes, you can see dragonflies flying low over the pond.

notes:
{飛|と}び{回|まわ}る is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to fly around.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ (to fly) + ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around) → to fly around

ASPECT (ている):
{飛|と}び{回|まわ}っている indicates an ongoing action of flying around.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飛|と}び{回|まわ}る (fly around the sky)
- ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧{飛|と}び{回|まわ}る (fly around everywhere)
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飛|と}び{回|まわ}る (fly around the world - often figurative for traveling extensively)

USAGE:
When used for people, {飛|と}び{回|まわ}る typically means to travel frequently, often by airplane, usually for business purposes.
